title: Your relay. Your cockpit.
summary: Optional space cockpit for bounded AI work: readiness and activity remain visible while task-specific reading decks open on demand.

source.scope: One enrolled owner console; recorded counts and rank are historical values for that relay.

timeline.observed: Rotating brass insignia, horizontal navigation, moving stars, readiness, projected activity, progress and New request.
Broad Jobs reading deck opens beneath the instruments, displays existing completed jobs, then retracts.
Overview deck opens and scrolls through progress, readiness, outcomes and recent activity.
Narrower Groq and System decks; System displays version, sequence and source commit.
Reading deck retracts; open windshield remains.

timelinePrecision: Approximate segments, not exact input-event timestamps. Transitions overlap segment boundaries.

sourceDocumentedControls.openDeck: Select Overview, Jobs, Requests, Groq or System in the horizontal navigation.
sourceDocumentedControls.utilities: Upper-right ellipsis menu: Documentation, motion and Sign out.
sourceDocumentedControls.statusRefresh: Refresh button; existing 15000 ms read-only visible-tab cadence. Does not reload interface source.
sourceDocumentedControls.softwareUpdate: System / Check for updates; separately enrolled host updater required.
sourceDocumentedControls.activeReadoutDefinition: Current source uses queued + invoking from a fresh scoped status observation; completed is saved responses.
